oneSentenceConcept: Stark typographic hierarchy and one confident accent reinterpret the hero as a signal, not decoration.
heroConcept: Overscaled headline, tight tracking, accent rule beneath the greeting — experimental only in the hero band.
emergingSignals: High-contrast neutrals with single accent discipline
Tight geometric radii and hard borders
Typographic weight as primary visual texture
Subtle motion limited to interactive affordances
visualLanguage: Direct, high-contrast, minimal surface noise — clarity over atmosphere.
interactionLanguage: Restrained hover on links and CTAs; no cursor gimmicks; navigation stays predictable.
motionLanguage: Subtle transitions on links and buttons; no ambient loops.
storytellingApproach: Lead with a single hero statement; supporting sections reveal context in calm sequence.
creativeTechnologyIdeas: CSS-only accent rule animation on hero load
typographyDirection: Bold sans display for hero; minimal body rhythm elsewhere.
compositionDirection: Hero-led vertical stack; supporting sections use muted bands and bordered cards.
colorDirection: White field, near-black type, one saturated accent for emphasis only.
textureDirection: Flat fills and border weight — no grain or glass unless contrast-safe.
supportingPageTreatment: Calmer cards and navigation; tokens echo hero accent sparingly.
